notes.title: Release Rambell
notes.notes:
It's done, Rambell is finished.

It's done, Rambell is finished and has now been officially released.

This is new in the release version:

 Bug Fixes
 New Achievements
 New Maps
 New Game Modes
 New Features
 Switch to UN 5.4


I wish you a lot of fun with the final release of the game. As much as possible, I will continue to work on the project, adding new maps and game modes. Through the development of this game, I have learned a lot and will now focus more on new projects.

Thank you for your feedback and assistance!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Rambell
notes.notes:
New Features:

Introduction of the Randem Mode in the Lobby: A brand-new Randem Mode is now available! Play exciting Randem game modes directly from the lobby. 

Changes:

Removal of game modes from the lobby host menu: Game modes have been removed from the lobby host menu to make room for the new Randem Mode. Now you can conveniently enjoy various game modes in the Randem Mode.

Thank you for playing Rambell! We hope you enjoy this update. Have fun gaming!
